_comment: Atomic action instructions for ranking three blocks in a row.
One fixed instruction per action (seen == unseen), matching the behaviour tree output.
{B} is the slot of the row the block is placed in, not another object, hence 'at' and
not the 'on' of the default place template.
Actions that are not listed here fall back to `_default.json`.

pick.schema: {A} is the block being picked up, {a} is the arm that picks it up

place.schema: {A} is the block being placed, {B} is the slot of the row it goes to, {a} is the arm that places it
